  (x : ℕ → ℝ)
  (hpos : ∀ n, 0 < x n)
  (hmono : ∀ n, x n ≥ x (n + 1))
  (hsq : ∀ N, (Ico 1 (N + 1)).sum (fun i => x (i * i) / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 1) :
  ∀ k, (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 3 := by

  -- define `m = ⌊√k⌋`

    have : m * m ≤ k := Nat.sqrt_mul_self_le k
    have hlt : k < (m + 1) * (m + 1) := Nat.lt_succ_self _
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt this hlt
  -- split the sum over the intervals `[j^2,(j+1)^2)`
  have hsplit :
      (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤
        (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j =>
          x (j * j) * ((Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))).sum (fun i => (1 : ℝ) / i))) := by
